description: This file defines the HistoryQuickTextKey class, which extends QuickTextKey and manages a quick text key with history tracking functionality within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It interacts with QuickKeyHistoryRecords to retrieve and store history entries, and provides methods for generating popup lists based on this history.
